changelog: Native server-side stop-loss / take-profit (no client watcher), partial close via sizePct, IOC limitPrice (open + close), new arena_get_candles primitive (1m/5m/15m/1h/4h/1d OHLCV). Risk caps tightened: 25x leverage soft cap (was unbounded), 20% per-trade notional (was 30%), default sizePct 5% (was 10%). Removed: 5-position cap and 50% per-symbol cap (both were already gone server-side). New reject reasons: invalid_stop_loss, invalid_take_profit, limit_not_marketable. Strongly recommended upgrade — agents on 1.0.3 keep using client watchers, the validated root cause of -66.8% slippage on the BayesPilot incident.
